docView.rejectedQt: This quotation was rejected; revise it into a new version or copy it as a new quotation

mark.acceptedBody: Records that the customer accepted this quotation. Totals do not change and no revision is made.
mark.rejectedBody: Records that the customer rejected this quotation. It cannot be converted until it is revised or copied as a new one.
mark.deliveredBody: Records that the goods on this order were delivered. A status only: no other document is issued and totals do not change.
mark.sentBody: Records that this purchase order was sent to the vendor. A status only: no other document is issued and totals do not change.

lock.hint: Allowed once every line up to that date is matched, posted or skipped. Afterwards cancelling a match needs bank.reconcile and a reason.

match.title: Find a match

match.noSuggestion: No suggestion. Search by document number or party.

post.final: Once posted it cannot be edited; reverse the journal if it is wrong

transfer.hint: Booked once: debit the receiving account, credit the paying one, and this line is matched. The other account's line is offered the same journal when an equal amount shows on its statement
